quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Energy press release: Advanced Energy Adds Single-Whip AC Input Option to  33 kW (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced Energy launched a single-whip option (one AC power connection per shelf, with separate left- and right-side input configurations) for its 33 kW ORv3 High-Power Rack (HPR) power shelf at the 2026 OCP Global Summit. The shelf holds six 5.5 kW hot-swappable power supply modules in one Open Rack Unit (1OU); a fully populated shelf delivers 33 kW without redundancy or 27.5 kW with N+1 redundancy, and multiple shelves can operate in parallel to power AI and high-performance computing racks requiring 100 kW or more. Monitoring options include an Ethernet-based controller compatible with DMTF Redfish. The ORv3 HPR power shelf family has been supporting a range of needs since 2023.
quarterly_data.figure: 33 kW ORv3 HPR shelf (six 5.5 kW modules, 1OU; 27.5 kW with N+1); parallel shelves for racks of 100 kW or more; single-whip option launched October 12, 2026
